source.title: Hypothesis: the network-addressed MOST sub-network of the L319, L320 and L322 of MY10 is reached on its main bus's route, through the ACM, by each module's own address
source.origin: JLR Scanner reasoning over the SDD platform documents PLATFORM_L319_201000.xml, PLATFORM_L320_201000.xml and PLATFORM_L322_201000.xml and the documented binding of CAN_MS to the adapter's ms-can route (ADR-0039)
source.provenance: Not a documented fact. The three MY10 platform documents declare SUB_MOST as a sub-network of CAN_MS behind the gateway module ACM_SYSTEM_A with access_method NETWORK_ADDRESSED, at 125 kbit/s with 11-bit identifiers under normal ISO 15765 addressing - the parameters of CAN_MS itself - and give its modules ordinary 11-bit diagnostic identifiers in the main bus's identifier space (AAM 0x7A4, APIM 0x7D0, DABM 0x7D6, DACMC 0x7D5, FEM 0x784, REM 0x771, SRM 0x782, TEL 0x781, TVM 0x707; CDP 0x770 on the L322). No routine is declared, where the same documents declare ROUTINE_CONTROL for every gateway that needs one. Hence the hypothesis that a request to such a module on the ms-can route is forwarded by the ACM without being asked, and its answer comes back the same way. Bound only for the documents that declare it so: L319 MY10-11 and L320 MY10-11, whose MY12 documents switch the sub-network to ROUTINE_CONTROL behind the FCDIM, and L322 MY10-12. The older L319, L320 and L322 documents address the same sub-network with a 29-bit enhanced layout the data does not compose, and are not bound. Confirmed per vehicle by the first answered read on such a car; refuted by its absence.
source.notes: Records here resolve as Unverified and the survey shows them as a hypothesis, never as a reachable route. The bench proves the resolution and the route on a synthetic sub-network; it proves nothing about an ACM.

locator.description: docs/adr/ADR-0039, Decision 2: a network-addressed sub-network with normal 11-bit addressing is reached on its main bus's route, as a hypothesis; the SDD declarations it rests on are quoted in the Context

evidence.excerpt: SUB_MOST: main_net CAN_MS, gateway ACM_SYSTEM_A, access_method NETWORK_ADDRESSED, 125 kbit/s, 11-bit, normal addressing; modules with 11-bit identifiers in the main bus's space; no routine declared
evidence.notes: Reasoning over SDD's declarations, not observation

locator.description: docs/adr/ADR-0039, Decision 6: the MY10 documents give a MOST module a physical address in the 11-bit identifier range and no can_tx/can_rx pair; it is read as the request identifier, and the response is eight above it - the convention every one of the 1,528 declared diagnostic can_tx/can_rx pairs in the 45 platform documents follows, measured 2026-09-19

evidence.excerpt: 1,528 of 1,528 declared diagnostic can_tx/can_rx pairs across PLATFORM_*.xml have can_rx = can_tx + 8; no document states that a physical address in the 0x700 range is a request identifier; exactly 31 module rows - the MOST rows of L319_201000, L320_201000 and L322_201000 - carry such an address
evidence.notes: A convention measured over the documents, not a statement in them; every derived 11-bit identifier cites this evidence and stays Unverified until the module answers
